notesDetails.title: 91.5% Cost Reduction vs. GLM-5.3 High ($1.10 vs. $12.90) with 6/7 Slices Verified (S5 Incomplete on Live Chunked 301)
bullets: $1.10 Total Run Cost: Running GLM-5.3-Flash with effort: "low" completed the benchmark workflow for $1.10 ($1.1025)—a 91.5% cost reduction compared to GLM-5.3 High ($12.90) on the same ZCode harness.

99.52% Prefix Cache Hit Rate Saved $4.11 (78.8%): Out of 34,374,813 total input tokens across 344 successful turns, 34,210,176 were served from cache (cacheReadTokens) with zero cache invalidations as context grew monotonically from 26,398 to 167,669 tokens.

Outside-In TDD Suite (42/42 Local Tests), but S5 Fails Against Live Chunked 301 Responses: While the agent's 42 local ExUnit tests passed in 41.4s with zero warnings under mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix credo --strict, manual S5 verification with ./cb http://rizafahmi.com failed due to a chunked transfer-encoding buffer bug in lib/capy_bench/http.ex.

notesDetails.title: S5 Verification Failure on './cb http://rizafahmi.com': Chunked-Body Buffer Drop Causes ':closed' Transport Failures
bullets: Failing Live 301 Redirect Check: Running ./cb http://rizafahmi.com (which returns a Cloudflare HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently response with Transfer-Encoding: chunked) fails 40 of 41 requests with Transport failures: 40 (Failure reasons: :closed: 40 on stderr) instead of counting completed 301 responses.

Root Cause in CapyBench.HTTP.read_chunk/5 (lib/capy_bench/http.ex): When reading a chunked body, read_chunk/5 calls read_n(socket, transport, String.to_integer(line, 16) + 2, rest, deadline), which consumes the chunk payload from rest and returns bare :ok—discarding the remaining bytes in rest (including the terminating 0\r\n\r\n chunk that arrived in the same TCP segment)—before calling read_chunked(socket, transport, "", deadline), which then blocks on transport.recv/3 until the server closes the connection ({:error, :closed}).

Skipped TodoWrite Updates on S5 & S6: In ZCode's TodoWrite state, the agent marked S5 in_progress at line 273 and never updated TodoWrite after committing S5 (line 290) or S6 (line 317), leaving S5 marked incomplete in the UI todo list until line 362.

notesDetails.title: Upstream Stream Instability in S1–S3: 29 'TypeError: terminated' Aborts & 58 Multi-Attempt Retries (~21m Lost)
bullets: 29 Mid-Stream SSE Aborts (10.58m Wasted): Between 18:52 and 20:00 (lines 1–213), 29 LLM responses aborted mid-stream after running for 9.4s to 67.0s each with TypeError: terminated inside Node's undici fetch stream, including a 4-error streak at lines 81–84 that burned 166.1s (2.8m) on a single turn.

58 Multi-Attempt Auto-Retries (~10.2m Unlogged Backoff): Across lines 1–223, 58 turns required internal retries before succeeding (46 on attempt 2, 10 on attempt 3, and 2 on attempt 4 at lines 80 and 145). On the 46 retry turns without a preceding error row, inter-turn gaps after fast local tools totaled 610.2s (10.17m) of unlogged failed-attempt and backoff latency.

Complete Recovery After Line 224: Only 2 stream drops required manual 'continue' nudges (lines 102 and 213, plus 1 after a cancelled Bash run at line 358, totaling 87.2s / 1.45m of idle time). From line 224 (20:04) through line 373 (20:44), all 150 final turns across S3–S7 succeeded on attempt 1 with zero stream terminations.

notesDetails.title: S3 Consumed 46.5% of Active Time (51.7m, 156 LLM Calls) Due to Five OTP/GenServer Traps
bullets: 1. macOS Keychain Ignores SSL_CERT_FILE (Lines 67–85, ~8m): The agent spent 15 turns probing :public_key.cacerts_get() in /tmp before confirming that OTP on macOS reads the system Keychain and ignores SSL_CERT_FILE, requiring explicit :public_key.cacerts_load(path) when SSL_CERT_FILE is set.

2. Misplacing extra_applications in mix.exs (Lines 127–146, ~7m): At line 128, it added extra_applications: [:logger, :ssl, :public_key, :crypto] inside def project instead of def application, then spent 18 turns investigating why :code.lib_dir(:ssl) returned {:error, :bad_name} under Mix before spotting its mix.exs placement bug at line 145.

3. Four TestServer GenServer Bugs (Lines 103–176, ~22m): In test/support/test_server.ex, it sequentially debugged (a) handling GenServer.call(:request) inside handle_info instead of handle_call (line 117), (b) blocking the GenServer inside :gen_tcp.accept/1 so worker GenServer.call messages timed out (line 149), (c) calling self() inside spawn(fn -> accept(..., self()) end) so workers messaged the acceptor PID instead of the GenServer (line 160), and (d) using GenServer.start_link/2 in TestServer.start/1 which crashed ExUnit teardown after TestServer.stop/1 (line 176).

4. Calling Removed :ssl.accept/2 on OTP 28 (Lines 183–198, ~4m): HTTPS test server connections crashed with UndefinedFunctionError on :ssl.accept/2 until replaced with :ssl.transport_accept/1 + :ssl.handshake/2 at line 195.

notesDetails.title: 5.5 MB erl_crash.dump Committed Four Times via 'git add -A' (877k Diff Lines)
bullets: Broken Pipe Crash Dumps from head/tail Pipelines: Piping Mix output into head or tail (such as mix compile 2>&1 | head -8 at line 295) closed stdout early while the BEAM was still writing to :standard_error, triggering an unhandled :badarg (:epipe) during VM termination and writing a 5.5 MB erl_crash.dump to the repo root.

Unignored Artifact Staged by git add -A: Because .gitignore only excluded /_build/, /deps/, and /cb.escript (line 31), running git add -A && git commit -q committed erl_crash.dump in S1 (8e68e2a, +215,252 lines) and updated it in S3 (24c538b, 284,165 lines changed), S6 (31c83ba, 205,614 lines changed), and S7 (faaa62c, 272,280 lines changed).

notesDetails.title: S7 Signal-Relay & POSIX 'wait' Exit-Status Debugging
bullets: Upfront S1 Probe (Lines 14–27): In /tmp/cbprobe, the agent verified that OTP 28 rejects :os.set_signal(:sigint, :handle) and default escripts ignore SIGINT, then validated swapping :erl_signal_server's handler via :gen_event.swap_handler/3 to catch :sigterm from a ./cb wrapper.

Two S7 Integration Bugs Caught Live (Lines 342–353): When testing real Ctrl-C in S7, it fixed (1) CapyBench.SignalHandler.init/1 crashing because :gen_event.swap_handler/3 passes {init_arg, term} rather than bare init_arg (line 344), and (2) the ./cb wrapper's wait loop treating the escript's legitimate exit code 130 (> 128) as an interrupted wait builtin and re-invoking wait $child, which returned 127 (fixed at lines 346–349 via kill -0).

notesDetails.title: ZCode File-State Guard Friction (18 Inline Python Patches & 1 Binary Overwrite Error)
bullets: 8 of 14 Edit Errors from Stale Read State: Running mix format or inline scripts invalidated ZCode's file-mtime tracker, causing 8 Edit calls (lines 174, 185, 204, 226, 236, 313, 321, 338) to fail with 'File has been modified since read' and 1 Read call (line 152) to be rejected as a 'Wasted call'. To avoid extra Read turns, the agent executed 18 file mutations via python3 - <<'EOF' inside Bash.

Binary Escript Overwrite Guard (Line 28): When converting ./cb from a compiled escript binary to a POSIX shell wrapper in S1, ZCode's Write tool rejected overwriting ./cb with 'Unsupported or binary text encoding', prompting the agent to write the wrapper via cat > cb <<'EOF' in Bash (line 29).
